title: [impl] Implement CLI create, update, delete subcommands
description:

- create: requires --title and --content; optional repeated --tag. POST /api/notes. Prints created note (with id). Non-zero exit on API error.
- update: requires --id; optional --title/--content/--tag. PUT /api/notes/:id. Prints updated note. 404 -> clear error + non-zero exit.
- delete: requires --id. DELETE /api/notes/:id. Prints confirmation. 404 -> clear error + non-zero exit.

- update changes fields via PUT and prints result; delete removes and confirms.
- Any API error / 404 -> clear user message, non-zero exit, no stack trace.

title: [impl] Create CLI scaffold: entrypoint, argv dispatch, HTTP client helper
description:
Foundational CLI infrastructure that all subcommands, --help, --version, and validation build on. This is the shared entrypoint file — treat it as a mutex resource (all CLI features touch it, so scaffold must land first).

Build:
- A CLI entrypoint (e.g. src/cli/index.ts) that parses process.argv into { subcommand, flags, positionals } without pulling in a heavy dependency (hand-rolled or a minimal parser). Do NOT add a database.
- A subcommand dispatch table (list/read/create/update/delete registered as stubs that later tasks fill in).
- A small HTTP client helper (e.g. src/cli/apiClient.ts) that calls the NoteAPI base URL (default http://localhost:3000, overridable via env e.g. NOTEAPI_URL) and returns parsed JSON, throwing a typed error on non-2xx.
- Global exit-code convention: 0 on success, non-zero on API/error paths. No stack traces printed to the user.
- A package.json script or bin wiring so the CLI is runnable (e.g. "cli": "ts-node src/cli/index.ts").

Files: src/cli/index.ts, src/cli/apiClient.ts, package.json (script). Keep to ~3 files.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- CLI can be invoked and dispatches to a named subcommand stub.
- Unknown subcommand exits non-zero with a clear one-line message (no stack trace).
- apiClient performs a GET and parses JSON; non-2xx throws a typed error carrying status.
- No any types; interfaces from src/models where relevant. Lint passes.
